evidence.command: read Collaboration.java field list and CreatorCampaignService.apply
evidence.result: applying persists a permanent Collaboration row with an immutable appliedAt, so the application itself survives; no event/history record is written alongside it

the only hits are ContentFlag.reviewedAt, CreatorProfile.applicationReviewedAt (platform onboarding review) and Deliverable.reviewedAt; none is a brand opening a campaign application, and no field, endpoint or UI records it

rows.subject: FR-03 track decision with timestamp and reason

evidence.command: read DealService.doReject and the RejectRequest DTO
evidence.result: RejectRequest carries an optional 500-char reason and doReject writes it into a timestamped system message; there is no structured acceptedAt/rejectedAt/rejectionReason column, so the decision time is recoverable only from that message

rows.subject: FR-04 activate deal room on acceptance

evidence.command: read CreatorCampaignService.apply and DealService accept path
evidence.result: the deal room is the Collaboration row itself, created at apply time and transitioned on acceptance, so the room is always present and correctly scoped once accepted

rows.subject: FR-05 direct navigation to the exact deal room

evidence.command: read CreatorApplicationCard click-through and creator-chat.tsx param handling
evidence.result: the card routes accepted applications to /creator/chat?deal=<dealId> under an 'Open deal room' label and creator-chat seeds its selection from that param

rows.subject: FR-06 show current deal room step

evidence.command: read deal-room-step-progress.tsx and its mount in creator-chat.tsx
evidence.result: the five phases match the FRD list exactly (Negotiate, Contract, Fund escrow, Deliver, Pay) with distinct current/completed/pending styling, and the creator deal room mounts it

evidence.command: read creator-applications.tsx, CreatorApplicationCard.tsx and the CreatorApplicationRow interface
evidence.result: the surface renders one card per application carrying a single date and one CTA; the row type has no events collection and no second timestamp, so no journey is displayed

evidence.command: read the deal message thread ordering and the applications list ordering
evidence.result: the deal message thread is ordered chronologically, which covers the two system events that exist; there is no application-level event list for ordering to apply to

evidence.command: read CreatorCampaignService.apply idempotency javadoc and body
evidence.result: a UNIQUE(campaign_id, creator_id) database constraint backs a pre-check plus a DataIntegrityViolationException catch for the concurrent race, so repeated clicks reuse the one row

evidence.command: read Collaboration lifecycle and DealMessage persistence
evidence.result: the collaboration row and its message thread persist indefinitely after completion, so what was captured stays available; the events the FRD lists were mostly never captured to begin with

evidence.command: read the canonical status map header and STATUS_LABELS
evidence.result: a prior CTO arbitration deliberately removed any Rejected state (CANCELLED renders as Closed) and maps TERMS_AGREED to 'In negotiation' rather than 'Accepted', which is the opposite of what FRD sections 4, 5 and 13 ask for — a standing product ruling the document contradicts
